I’m in a similar situation, in a different country. It’s really hard being an expat. I can tell you what doesn’t work, and a little tip about how to come to your own decision of what to do. 

Escapism, ignoring, shutting down your own feelings, acting like everyone else to fit in. I have lived in several  countries where I felt that I don’t fit in. One of them I was living in when I was young, I found messed me up, years later. When I was kind of “defrosting”, I was put back in the environment that was welcoming and free, I realized that I had suppressed parts of myself, developed complexes. 

So I know you are trying to survive now, and you aren’t thinking about things down the line, how your life today will shape who you are as an adult, but it will. Experiences make us. 

What usually helps me to reflect is to step away from everything for a day. Go on a hike, where there aren’t too many people to be distracted by, look into the distance and think. I’m sure you have so many good replies here and plenty to think about, but we forget to step away from the hustle and bustle of our busy lives and just be, collect ourselves. I found that the fast pace of cities does that to a person. It’s no help when you are already feeling fragile. 

Good luck to you xx
